[Colors] pumpkin orange #e8751c, parchment cream #f3e3c6, deep violet #4b2364, gold #e0a83c, cast-iron black. [Layout] cartoon header band at the top with two ghost mascots flanking the display wordmark, a castle and moon behind, an orange ribbon strip with the offer line, a cream menu card in the middle holding two price rows divided by dashed rules, a dark information block with date and perks, then a photographic platter of food across the bottom. [Typography] painted wooden-sign letterforms with a slight outline, hand-lettered ribbon text, bold red numerals. [Subject] a chef ghost lifting a cloche and a witch-hat ghost waving a fork, a small black cauldron, a carved pumpkin with a purple hat; below, a mixed grill platter with ribs, potatoes and herbs, a shrimp bowl, and a small dessert ghost. [Lighting & mood] warm tavern glow, festive and friendly. [Details] brush texture in the lettering, dashed card rules, grill marks, rising steam. Text: "HALLOWEEN BUFFET", "$36", "OCT 25-NOV 2".
